lcc_sn: 都進<WH0935><WTH8799>到<WAH0413>挪亞<WH05146>那裏，入<WAH0413>了樓船<WH08392>。凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>有血肉<WH01320>的，就是<WH0834>裏面<WAH09002>有生氣<WH07307>的活物<WH02416>，都兩隻<WH08147>兩隻地<WH08147>進去，
lcc_original: 都進到挪亞那裏，入了樓船。凡有血肉的，就是裏面有生氣的活物，都兩隻兩隻地進去，
notes: LCC restructures the sentence: the action clause (都進到挪亞那裏，入了樓船) front-loads the main verb, while the descriptive subject (凡有血肉的...活物) follows with a repeated motion verb 進去. SNs are distributed across both clauses accordingly.

H935 (בּוֹא 'come/enter') attached to 進 in 進到; 進去 at the end of LCC's descriptive clause left unannotated — it is LCC's structural addition for the rearranged subject clause, not a second Hebrew verb occurrence.
H834 (אֲשֶׁר, implicit in UNV via {}) made explicit in LCC as 就是 ('that is/namely'); braces dropped, attached as 就是<WH0834>.
H09002 (בּ prefix in בּוֹ 'in it', implicit in UNV via {}) made explicit in LCC as 裏面 ('inside/within'); braces dropped, attached as 裏面<WAH09002>.
入 in 入了樓船 tagged as WAH0413 (second אֶל, 'into the ark'), matching UNV's split of 進<WH0935>入<WAH0413>方舟 — 入 functions as directional complement 'into' while 進 carries the main verb semantics.
LCC 樓船 ('multi-storey vessel') = UNV 方舟, both H8392 (תֵּבָה). LCC 生氣 = UNV 氣息, both H7307 (רוּחַ).
